download_text_heavy_edit_data: download text heavy edit data to a specified directory using local processed JSONL data
load_prompts_from_jsonl: load prompts from a text heavy edit JSONL file and return a dictionary of prompt data
setup_source_directory: set up the text heavy edit source directory and check if local data is configured
copy_images_to_output: copy images referenced in prompt data to the output images directory during prompt loading
configure_jsonl_env_var: configure the TEXT_HEAVY_EDIT_JSONL environment variable to point to local processed data
